parakeet: Many pastors go beyond spiritual guidance and seek to control your personal decisions, from who you vote for, to who you love, to how you parent. This isn't just advice. It's social pressure disguised as doctrine. Some churches even shun members who step out of line using ostracization as a means of control. If you challenge the pastor's authority or question a doctrine, you may find yourself quietly pushed out or publicly shamed. It's not just faith, it's a power structure designed to maintain order and compliance. I once tried to post a very neutral comment on a controversial topic, and next thing I knew, I was hauled into several spiritual concern meetings with church leaders.
